newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fire destroys Philippine armed forces building.
newsitem.headline: Fire destroys Philippine armed forces building.

text.p: A New Year's Eve fire on Tuesday destroyed the logistics command building inside the Philippines' Camp Aguinaldo, the armed forces headquarters, in Manila but there were no casualties, officials said.
Logistics command chief Commodore Ruperto Andaya said the building housed different offices and there were no military supplies, such as guns or ammunition, inside.

Military sources said they feared important documents might have been destroyed, including inventories of weapons stolen by army rebels during a series of six failed coup attempts between 1986 and 1989 against then president Corazon Aquino.
Tuesday was a national holiday in the Philippines and soldiers at the fire scene said the building was unoccupied.
Initial reports indicated the hour-long fire was caused by faulty wiring, Andaya said.
